Subject: DPA + order form redlines — evidence & roles we need from Redwood

Vivek —

Thanks for the demo last week. Legal and procurement asked me to surface a couple of items they need before we can move the Order Form + MSA redline forward:

1) Clear delegation on controller/processor roles for (i) embeddings storage, (ii) hosted API telemetry, and (iii) private deployment backups. We need a short matrix we can attach to our DPA annex.
2) Evidence for encryption at rest and KMS design (certificate or architecture note is fine).
3) Complete subprocessor list and a proposed cadence for updates to that list.
4) Confirmation if Redwood can accept the SCCs-based transfer addendum we proposed or whether you need the full EU addendum we included in the redline.

Attached: Prospect_MSA_Redlines_Anna.pdf (redlines), Prospect_OrderForm_v2.pdf (current order form)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can supply the evidence items and a go/no-go on our SCCs ask by EOD Friday? If not, propose a short meeting window — procurement is hoping to finalize signatures next week.

Appreciate it —
Anna Lewis

Hi Anna —

Thanks for the clear list and the redlines. Short answer: we can get you most of this, and we have a couple of follow-ups to align on scope. Proposed plan below — happy to sync in a 30-minute slot if that helps.

What Redwood will deliver by Fri EOD (target):
- Role matrix (controller/processor) for embeddings storage, telemetry, and backups — short CSV + one-page explanation.
- KMS architecture note (includes regions, HSM options, and key rotation cadence).
- Current subprocessor list + commitment on 30-day notice for additions; propose quarterly summary for heavy customers.

Open items we want to confirm with you:
- SCCs vs. full EU addendum: Ben (cc'd) is reviewing the legal implication of your proposed SCCs addendum. If Prospect requires the full addendum with delegation language, that will be flagged as a contract exception and routed to our legal approvals. Please confirm which path you'd prefer (SCCs addendum or your full addendum).
- Evidence format: for KMS we will provide a short architecture PDF and a certificate stub. For telemetry, we will provide a list of telemetry types collected and retention windows. Is a simple one-page summary acceptable for both?

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Redline_vv.docx (track changes), OrderForm_comments.pdf (inline comments)

If that looks OK I will: (1) have Ben drop the legal/ops note on acceptable clause text and approvals path, and (2) schedule a 30-min working call for Thursday afternoon CET to walk through the redlines.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: DPA + order form redlines — evidence & roles we need from Redwood

Vivek / Laura —

Quick legal/ops read: I reviewed Prospect's redline and Vivek's DPA track-changes. High-level notes and proposed next steps:

- SCCs vs full addendum: our standard practice is to accept SCCs with an addendum when there is no additional liability or localization ask. Prospect's redline includes a few liability escalators (Sections 6 and 9) — we can accept SCCs if those escalators are removed or clarified. Otherwise, this becomes a C-suite exception.

- Roles matrix: we should mark embeddings storage as 'processor' for Redwood-hosted embeddings, telemetry as 'processor' (customer-provided prompts are controller content), and backups depend on hosting choice (private-deploy backups = controller option; hosted backups we propose 'processor with limited access'). I put suggested wording into DPA_clause_suggestions.txt (attached).

- Evidence: KMS: we can provide an architecture note and HSM attestation (non-prod cert redacted). Telemetry: provide list + retention; NOT raw prompt content.

- Subprocessors: we will provide the current list. Suggest we commit to 30 days' notice and a soft SLA for substantiating items (we've had customers accept 30-day cadence).

Action items for this thread:
1) Vivek: confirm preferred meeting time Thu 14:00-16:00 CET and we'll invite procurement + legal contact.
2) Laura: please prepare the short role matrix + one-liner per row.
3) I'll draft a concise escalation note explaining when a full addendum becomes necessary (if Prospect keeps escalator language).

Attachments: DPA_clause_suggestions.txt (plain text suggestions)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/53421/company/ProspectHealth (tracking)

Ben Carter
